items.title: From Decorative to Load-Bearing: Task Difficulty Shapes the Causal Role of Chain-of-Thought
items.title_zh: 从装饰到承重：任务难度塑造思维链的因果作用
items.summary: The paper introduces continuation-based causal testing, which perturbs one reasoning step, truncates the chain and forces the model to continue, to measure how load-bearing chain-of-thought is for the final answer. Across three models and three benchmarks it finds CoT load-bearingness tracks task-relative difficulty, with error propagation rising 16x from GSM8K to BBH multistep arithmetic and 98.8% of explained deviance attributed to task difficulty.

items.title: OBLIQ-IR: Training a Dense Retriever for Oblique Queries
items.title_zh: OBLIQ-IR：为隐晦查询训练稠密检索器
items.summary: OBLIQ-IR is a single-vector dense retriever trained with per-mechanism synthetic queries and kNN-graph distillation from a frozen authorship encoder to handle oblique queries whose relevance has little surface expression. A 3B retriever fine-tune reaches NDCG@10 of 0.211 on Writing-Style, 0.171 on Math, 0.177 on Twitter and 0.281 on Congress, improving over the GPT-5.2 Multi-Hop Agent on every reported task, with code and checkpoints released.

items.title: DolphinBench: Mapping the Pareto Frontier of Agent Memory
items.title_zh: DolphinBench：绘制智能体记忆的帕累托前沿
items.summary: DolphinBench evaluates memory through an agent's task completion rather than conversational question answering, with three knowledge-work personas of roughly 500k tokens each and 200 tasks per persona verified to succeed with the relevant history and fail without it. It requires every evaluation to report total cost and latency alongside accuracy.

items.title: Learned Enterprise Data Comprehension: Compression and Routing for Data Agents
items.title_zh: 学习式企业数据理解：面向数据智能体的压缩与路由
items.summary: The paper introduces latent equivalence learning, which separates persistent task-relevant identities from dataset-relative realizations and uses a learned query-prototype system to route evidence for data agents. On the Data Agent Benchmark it reports 94.67% dataset-macro stratified Pass@1 over five trials, versus 55.51% for the Claude Opus 4.6 reference agent, ranking first among 40 leaderboard entries at submission.

items.title: RRSI: Regularized Recursive Self-Improvement of Agent Harnesses
items.title_zh: RRSI：智能体框架的规范化递归自我改进
items.summary: RRSI adds regularization to automated harness self-improvement, using a temporally annealed proposal budget, exploration of unseen trajectories, a critic that screens benchmark-specific proposals and a pruner for changes that are too small, expensive or no longer useful. Across eight benchmarks it gains up to 6.0 points in-distribution and up to 4.3 points on five out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a harness that uses 30% fewer policy tokens.

items.title: Trains but Doesn't Learn: A Post-Training Delivery Benchmark for LLM Agents as Forward-Deployed Engineers
items.title_zh: 训练却不学习：面向作为前置部署工程师的 LLM 智能体的后训练交付基准
items.summary: The paper seats LLM agents in the forward-deployed-engineer role on a governed delivery plane where an oracle scores ten post-training stages from platform-recorded facts, and identifies the silent failure of runs that train but do not learn. It runs four frontier agents end to end on metered L40S, A100 and H200 GPUs across 8B to 70B open bases and compares each against a human FDE arm under the same oracle.

items.title: ShowTellArena: Evaluating Business Workflow Understanding from Demonstrations
items.title_zh: ShowTellArena：从演示中评估业务流程理解
items.summary: ShowTellArena is a benchmark protocol and public dataset for testing what an agent understood from narrated business demonstrations, with 50 workflow tasks, recordings, screenshots, narration and 502 questions across finance, hiring, procurement, inventory and logistics. Pilot analysis covers 218 selected attempts across 39 workflow cases and is described as exploratory rather than a controlled product ranking.

items.title: RAG-NAROK: Retrieval-Aware Knowledge Corpus Poisoning in RAG with Source-specific Refutation
items.title_zh: RAG-NAROK：具备来源特定反驳的检索感知型 RAG 知识库投毒
items.summary: RAG-NAROK is an adaptive knowledge-base poisoning framework that extracts the legitimate source identities retrieved for a query, then generates Anchor-Specific Refutation documents that name and devalue those sources while exploiting recency and authority biases. It reports significantly outperforming static poisoning baselines across diverse domains.

items.title: Building standards for the next phase of AI
items.title_zh: 为下一阶段的 AI 建立标准
items.summary: OpenAI outlines a path to shared global AI standards, calling for coordinated evaluation, reporting and governance to improve safety.

items.title: V7 cuts costs 78% while boosting accuracy with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.title_zh: V7 借助 GPT-5.6 Luna 将成本降低 78% 并提升准确率
items.summary: Using GPT-5.6, V7 turns scattered company files into context agents can use to complete complex, source-linked work, according to OpenAI's customer story.
